angband.knowledge.monster.filthy_street_: He looks squalid and thoroughly revolting.
angband.knowledge.monster.scrawny_cat.de: A skinny little furball with sharp claws and a menacing look.
angband.knowledge.monster.scruffy_little: A thin flea-ridden mutt, growling as you get close.
He's lost his dogs.  He's had his mushrooms stolen.  He's not a happy hobbit!
angband.knowledge.monster.blubbering_idi: He tends to blubber a lot.
angband.knowledge.monster.boil_covered_w: Ugly doesn't begin to describe him.
Drooling and comical, but then, what do you expect?
angband.knowledge.monster.pitiful_lookin: You just can't help feeling sorry for him.
angband.knowledge.monster.mangy_looking_: You feel it isn't safe to touch him.
angband.knowledge.monster.squint_eyed_ro: A hardy, street-wise crook that knows an easy catch when it sees one.
angband.knowledge.monster.singing_happy_: He makes you glad to be sober.
angband.knowledge.monster.aimless_lookin: The typical ponce around town, with purse jingling, and looking for more amulets of adornment to buy.
angband.knowledge.monster.mean_looking_m: No job is too low for him.
angband.knowledge.monster.battle_scarred: He doesn't take to strangers kindly.
angband.knowledge.monster.red_hatted_elf: It's Yuletide and this elf has had a few too many.
angband.knowledge.monster.father_christm: It's Saint Nick, out delivering presents to the town urchins.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_yellow_c: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.
angband.knowledge.monster.white_icky_thi: It is a smallish, slimy, icky creature.
angband.knowledge.monster.clear_icky_thi: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, blobby creature.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_white_mo: It is about three feet long with large teeth.
angband.knowledge.monster.large_white_sn: It is about eight feet long.
angband.knowledge.monster.small_kobold.d: It is a squat and ugly humanoid figure with a canine face.
angband.knowledge.monster.white_worm_mas: It is a large slimy mass of worms.
angband.knowledge.monster.floating_eye.d: A disembodied eye, floating a few feet above the ground.
angband.knowledge.monster.rock_lizard.de: It is a small lizard with a hardened hide.
angband.knowledge.monster.wild_dog.descr: It is a yapping snarling dog, dangerous when in a pack.
angband.knowledge.monster.soldier_ant.de: A large ant with powerful mandibles.
angband.knowledge.monster.kobold.descrip: It is a small, dog-headed humanoid.
angband.knowledge.monster.shrieker_mushr: Yum!  It looks quite tasty.  It doesn't sound so nice, though...
angband.knowledge.monster.blubbering_ick: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, hungry creature.
angband.knowledge.monster.acolyte.descri: He is tripping over his priestly robes.
angband.knowledge.monster.apprentice.des: He is leaving behind a trail of dropped spell components.
angband.knowledge.monster.white_jelly.de: It's a large pile of white flesh.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_green_fr: It is as big as a wolf.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_black_an: It is about three feet long.
angband.knowledge.monster.salamander.des: A small black and orange lizard.
angband.knowledge.monster.white_harpy.de: A flying, screeching bird with a woman's face.
angband.knowledge.monster.grip_farmer_ma: A rather vicious dog belonging to Farmer Maggot.  It thinks you are stealing mushrooms.
angband.knowledge.monster.cave_spider.de: It is a black spider that moves in fits and starts.
angband.knowledge.monster.wild_cat.descr: A larger than normal feline, hissing loudly.  Its velvet paws conceal a fistful of needles.
angband.knowledge.monster.crow.descripti: It is a hooded crow, gray except for the black wings and head.
angband.knowledge.monster.smeagol.descri: Usually known as Gollum.  He's been sneaking, and he wants his 'precious.'
angband.knowledge.monster.poltergeist.de: It is a ghastly, ghostly form.
angband.knowledge.monster.black_naga.des: A large black serpent's body with a female torso.
angband.knowledge.monster.silver_jelly.d: It is a large pile of silver flesh that sucks all light from its surroundings.
angband.knowledge.monster.yellow_jelly.d: It's a large pile of yellow flesh.
angband.knowledge.monster.scruffy_lookin: A short little guy, in bedraggled clothes.  He appears to be looking for a good tavern.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_white_an: It is about two feet long and has sharp pincers.
angband.knowledge.monster.yellow_mold.de: It is a strange yellow growth on the dungeon floor.
angband.knowledge.monster.clear_worm_mas: It is a disgusting mass of poisonous worms.
A disembodied eye, crackling with energy.
It is a kobold dressed in skins and gesturing wildly.
angband.knowledge.monster.cave_lizard.de: It is an armoured lizard with a powerful bite.
angband.knowledge.monster.scout.descript: An agile hunter, ready and relaxed.
angband.knowledge.monster.gallant.descri: An adventurer both devoutly religious and skillful in combat.
angband.knowledge.monster.blue_jelly.des: It's a large pile of pulsing blue flesh.
angband.knowledge.monster.creeping_coppe: It appears to be a pile of copper coins.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_white_ra: It is a very vicious rodent.
angband.knowledge.monster.large_grey_sna: It is about ten feet long.
It is an ugly dog-headed humanoid wielding a bow.
angband.knowledge.monster.silver_mouse.d: It is about three feet long with large teeth.  As the light of your lamp falls on it, it seems to grow stronger.
angband.knowledge.monster.bullroarer_the: He is a sturdy hobbit who is renowned for his unusual strength and vigour.  He can prove a troublesome opponent.
angband.knowledge.monster.green_naga.des: A large green serpent with a female's torso.  Her green skin glistens with acid.
angband.knowledge.monster.green_glutton_: It is a very ugly green ghost with a voracious appetite.
angband.knowledge.monster.green_jelly.de: It is a large pile of pulsing green flesh.
angband.knowledge.monster.large_kobold.d: It is a man-sized figure with the all too recognizable face of a kobold.
angband.knowledge.monster.skeleton_kobol: It is a small animated kobold skeleton.
angband.knowledge.monster.grey_icky_thin: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, nasty creature.
angband.knowledge.monster.disenchanter_e: A disembodied eye, crackling with magic.
angband.knowledge.monster.copperhead_sna: It has a copper head and sharp venomous fangs.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_white_dr: It is a large fly that drips frost.
angband.knowledge.monster.rot_jelly.desc: It is a large pile of rotting flesh, whose touch spoils your food.  The terrible smell it exudes is also very hard to get rid of...
angband.knowledge.monster.brown_mold.des: A strange brown growth on the dungeon floor.
angband.knowledge.monster.creeping_silve: It appears to be a pile of silver coins.
angband.knowledge.monster.snaga.descript: He is one of the many weaker 'slave' orcs, often mistakenly known as a goblin.
angband.knowledge.monster.rattlesnake.de: It is recognized by the hard-scaled end of its body that is often rattled to frighten its prey.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_black_dr: The size of a large bird, this fly drips caustic acid.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_gold_dra: Large beating wings support this dazzling insect.  A loud buzzing noise pervades the air.
angband.knowledge.monster.crow_of_durtha: A crook-beaked bird with bedraggled black feathers.  It mocks you, and you realise that its scorn can kill.
angband.knowledge.monster.cave_orc.descr: He is often found in huge numbers in deep caves.
A disembodied eye, bloodshot and nasty.
angband.knowledge.monster.red_naga.descr: A large red snake with a woman's torso.
angband.knowledge.monster.red_jelly.desc: It is a large pulsating mound of red flesh.
angband.knowledge.monster.green_icky_thi: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, acidic creature.
angband.knowledge.monster.zombified_kobo: It is an animated kobold corpse.  Flesh falls off in large chunks as it shambles forward.
A dwarf of one of the eastern kindreds who has fallen under the sway of Morgoth.
angband.knowledge.monster.night_lizard.d: It is a black lizard with overlapping scales and a powerful jaw.
angband.knowledge.monster.mughash_the_ko: Strong and powerful, for a kobold.
angband.knowledge.monster.wormtongue_age: He's been spying for Saruman.  He is a snivelling wretch with no morals and disgusting habits.
angband.knowledge.monster.lagduf_the_sna: A captain of a regiment of weaker orcs, Lagduf keeps his troop in order with displays of excessive violence.
angband.knowledge.monster.terrified_yeek: It is a strange small humanoid in a constant state of extreme terror.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_salamand: A large black and yellow lizard.  You'd better run away!
angband.knowledge.monster.green_mold.des: It is a strange growth on the dungeon floor.
angband.knowledge.monster.skeleton_orc.d: It is an animated orc skeleton.
angband.knowledge.monster.lemure.descrip: It is a minor but aggressive demon.
angband.knowledge.monster.orc_tracker.de: A small orc with wide and snuffling nostrils.
angband.knowledge.monster.ruffian.descri: An uncultured brute with a club, a sling and a whip.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_black_lo: It makes you itch just to look at it.
angband.knowledge.monster.yeti.descripti: A large white figure covered in shaggy fur.
angband.knowledge.monster.bloodshot_icky: It is a strange, slimy, icky creature.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_grey_rat: It is a rodent of unusual size.
angband.knowledge.monster.black_harpy.de: A woman's face on the body of a vicious black bird.
angband.knowledge.monster.orc_shaman.des: An orc dressed in skins who gestures wildly.
angband.knowledge.monster.baby_blue_drag: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a pale blue.
angband.knowledge.monster.baby_white_dra: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a pale white.
angband.knowledge.monster.baby_green_dra: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a sickly green.
angband.knowledge.monster.baby_black_dra: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a dull black.
angband.knowledge.monster.baby_red_drago: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a pale red.
It is large and has venomous mandibles.
angband.knowledge.monster.brodda_the_eas: A nasty piece of work, Brodda picks on defenseless women and children.
angband.knowledge.monster.king_cobra.des: It is a large snake with a hooded face.
angband.knowledge.monster.baby_gold_drag: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a pale gold.
angband.knowledge.monster.cave_bear.desc: A large bear appears to have made its home in this cave.  It is hungry, and you are trespassing in its territory.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_spider.d: It is a vast black spider whose bulbous body is bloated with poison.
angband.knowledge.monster.blacklock_mage: A corrupted dwarf from the east, dressed in black mail, hurling spells at you.
angband.knowledge.monster.orfax_son_of_b: He's just like his daddy!  He knows mighty spells, but fortunately he is a yeek.
angband.knowledge.monster.stonefoot_warr: A dwarf of the east in a coat of iron rings and wielding an axe.
angband.knowledge.monster.grishnakh_the_: He is a cunning and devious orc with a chaotic nature.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_white_ti: It is moving slowly towards you.
angband.knowledge.monster.hairy_mold.des: It is a strange hairy growth on the dungeon floor.
angband.knowledge.monster.disenchanter_m: It is a strange glowing growth on the dungeon floor.
A small relative of the dragon that inhabits dark caves.
angband.knowledge.monster.tengu.descript: It is a fast-moving demon that blinks quickly in and out of existence; no other demon matches its teleporting mastery.
angband.knowledge.monster.creeping_gold_: It appears to be a pile of gold coins, until it starts crawling towards you on tiny legs.
angband.knowledge.monster.wolf.descripti: It howls and snaps at you.
angband.knowledge.monster.panther.descri: A large black cat, stalking you with intent.  It thinks you're its next meal.
angband.knowledge.monster.witch.descript: She is dressed in black and smells of decay.
angband.knowledge.monster.baby_multi_hue: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales shimmering with hints of many different colours.
angband.knowledge.monster.hippogriff.des: A strange hybrid of eagle and horse.  It looks weird.
It is a shambling orcish corpse leaving behind a trail of flesh.
angband.knowledge.monster.druadan_mage.d: A mage of short stature with stumpy legs and a wispy beard.
angband.knowledge.monster.old_forest_tre: An ancient tree that seems to be watching you.
angband.knowledge.monster.black_mamba.de: It has glistening black skin, a sleek body and highly venomous fangs.
angband.knowledge.monster.white_wolf.des: A large and muscled wolf from the northern wastes.  Its breath is cold and icy and its fur coated in frost.
angband.knowledge.monster.grape_jelly.de: Yum!  It looks quite tasty.  It is a pulsing mound of glowing flesh.
angband.knowledge.monster.nether_worm_ma: It is a disgusting mass of dark worms, eating each other, the floor, the air, you....
angband.knowledge.monster.golfimbul_the_: A leader of a band of raiding orcs, he picks on hobbits.
angband.knowledge.monster.master_yeek.de: A small humanoid that radiates some power.
angband.knowledge.monster.priest.descrip: A robed man, dedicated to his god.
angband.knowledge.monster.ironfist_pries: A dwarf of the east, dressed all in black, chanting words of dark sorcery.
angband.knowledge.monster.skeleton_human: It is an animated human skeleton.
angband.knowledge.monster.zombified_huma: It is a shambling human corpse dropping chunks of flesh behind it.
angband.knowledge.monster.tiger.descript: One of the largest of its species, a sleek orange and black shape creeps towards you, ready to pounce.
angband.knowledge.monster.moaning_spirit: A ghostly apparition that shrieks horribly.
angband.knowledge.monster.stegocentipede: It is a vast armoured centipede with massive mandibles and a spiked tail.
A strange jelly thing, covered in discoloured blotches.
angband.knowledge.monster.killer_brown_b: It is a vicious insect with a tough carapace.
angband.knowledge.monster.ochre_jelly.de: A fast moving highly acidic jelly thing, that is eating away the floor it rests on.
angband.knowledge.monster.boldor_king_of: A great yeek, powerful in magic and sorcery, but a yeek all the same.
angband.knowledge.monster.ogre.descripti: A hideous, smallish giant that is often found near or with orcs.
angband.knowledge.monster.creeping_mithr: It appears to be a pile of sentient mithril coins that doesn't like being picked up.
angband.knowledge.monster.orc_archer.des: He has a bow of horn and a quiver full of black-feathered arrows.
angband.knowledge.monster.ufthak_of_ciri: A strong orc guarding the pass of Cirith Ungol.  He is mortally afraid of spiders.
angband.knowledge.monster.blue_icky_thin: It is a strange, slimy, icky creature, with rudimentary intelligence, but evil cunning.  It hungers for food, and you look tasty.
angband.knowledge.monster.flesh_golem.de: A shambling humanoid monster with long scars.
angband.knowledge.monster.warg.descripti: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning.
angband.knowledge.monster.lurker.descrip: A strange creature that merges with the dungeon floor, trapping its victims by enveloping them within its perfectly disguised form.
angband.knowledge.monster.wererat.descri: A large rat with glowing red eyes.  The wererat is a disgusting creature, relishing in filth and disease.
angband.knowledge.monster.black_ogre.des: A massive orc-like figure with black skin and powerful arms.
angband.knowledge.monster.magic_mushroom: Yum!  It looks quite tasty.  It seems to glow with an unusual light.
A giant snake-like figure with a woman's torso.
angband.knowledge.monster.light_hound.de: A brilliant canine form whose light hurts your eyes, even at this distance.
angband.knowledge.monster.dark_hound.des: A hole in the air in the shape of a huge hound.  No light falls upon its form.
angband.knowledge.monster.half_orc.descr: He is a hideous deformed cross-breed with man and orc, combining man's strength and cunning with orcish evil.  The traitorous wizard Saruman is generally believed to be responsible for this abomination.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_tarantul: A giant, fast-moving spider with hairy black and red legs.
angband.knowledge.monster.griffon.descri: It is half lion, half eagle.  It flies menacingly towards you.
angband.knowledge.monster.homunculus.des: It is a small demonic spirit full of malevolence.
angband.knowledge.monster.clay_golem.des: It is a massive animated statue made out of hardened clay.
A giant bat, the beating of whose wings produces a strangely unnerving noise.
angband.knowledge.monster.umber_hulk.des: This bizarre creature has glaring eyes and large mandibles capable of slicing through rock.
angband.knowledge.monster.gelatinous_cub: It is a strange, vast gelatinous structure that assumes cubic proportions as it lines all four walls of the corridors it patrols.  Through its transparent jelly structure you can see treasures it has engulfed, and a few corpses as well.
angband.knowledge.monster.quasit.descrip: A demon of small stature with an annoying bite.
angband.knowledge.monster.uruk.descripti: A cunning orc of power, as tall as a man, and stronger.  It fears little.
angband.knowledge.monster.grizzly_bear.d: A huge, beastly bear, more savage than most of its kind.
angband.knowledge.monster.craban.descrip: A type of crow, specially bred by the forces of evil as spies; their rudimentary intelligence guided by an evil mind has tracked you down, and now they seek to alert other evil creatures to your presence.
angband.knowledge.monster.forest_troll.d: He is green skinned, ugly and stupid.
The friend and companion of the dwarven king Thrór, he went mad with grief after Thrór's death at the hands of Azog the Orc.  With torn beard and ragged clothes, he seems to have fixed on you as a convenient target to vent his anger.
angband.knowledge.monster.2_headed_hydra: A strange reptilian hybrid with two heads, guarding its hoard.
angband.knowledge.monster.earth_spirit.d: A whirling form of sentient rock.
angband.knowledge.monster.hummerhorn.des: A giant buzzing wasp, its stinger drips venom.
angband.knowledge.monster.orc_captain.de: An armoured orc with an air of authority.
angband.knowledge.monster.blackguard.des: A hulking figure encased in deep black plate armour; he looks at you menacingly.
angband.knowledge.monster.fire_hound.des: Flames lick at its feet and its tongue is a blade of fire.  You can feel a furnace heat radiating from the creature.
angband.knowledge.monster.cold_hound.des: A hound as tall as a man, this creature appears to be composed of angular planes of ice.  Cold radiates from it and freezes your breath in the air.
angband.knowledge.monster.energy_hound.d: Saint Elmo's Fire forms a ghostly halo around this hound, and sparks sting your fingers as energy builds up in the air around you.
angband.knowledge.monster.potion_mimic.d: A strange creature that disguises itself as a discarded potion bottle to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.
angband.knowledge.monster.blink_dog.desc: A strange magical member of the canine race, its form seems to shimmer and fade in front of your very eyes.
angband.knowledge.monster.shambling_moun: A pile of rotting vegetation that slides towards you with a disgusting stench, waking all it nears.
angband.knowledge.monster.evil_eye.descr: A huge disembodied eye.  As you stare into the black nothingness of its pupil, you feel your will and vitality draining away, and are unable to do anything except approach it in horrified fascination.
angband.knowledge.monster.shagrat_the_or: He is an orc of power and great cunning, leader of the garrison at Cirith Ungol.
angband.knowledge.monster.gorbag_the_orc: He is an orc of power and great cunning, leader of the garrison at Minas Morgul.
angband.knowledge.monster.stone_golem.de: It is a massive animated statue.
angband.knowledge.monster.red_mold.descr: It is a strange red growth on the dungeon floor; it seems to burn with flame.
angband.knowledge.monster.old_man_willow: The ancient grey willow tree, ruler of the Old Forest.  He despises trespassers in his territory.  "...a huge willow-tree, old and hoary.  Enormous it looked, its sprawling branches going up like racing arms with many long-fingered hands, its knotted and twisted trunk gaping in wide fissures that creaked faintly as the boughs moved."
angband.knowledge.monster.blood_falcon.d: A blinding whirlwind of fear and feathers.  Its razor sharp beak and talons fill its foes with terror as it seeks to rend flesh from bone with unbridled ferocity.
angband.knowledge.monster.mirkwood_spide: A strong and powerful spider from Mirkwood forest.  Cunning and evil, it seeks to taste your juicy insides.
angband.knowledge.monster.bolg_son_of_az: A large and powerful orc, he looks just like his father.  He is tall and fast, but fortunately blessed with orcish brains.
angband.knowledge.monster.3_headed_hydra: A 2-headed hydra with an extra head, its mouth dripping venom.
angband.knowledge.monster.earth_hound.de: A beautiful crystalline shape does not disguise the danger this hound clearly presents.  Your flesh tingles as it approaches.
angband.knowledge.monster.air_hound.desc: Swirling vapours surround this beast as it floats towards you, seemingly walking on air.  Noxious gases sting your throat.
angband.knowledge.monster.sabre_tooth_ti: A fierce and dangerous cat, its huge tusks and sharp claws would lacerate even the strongest armour.
angband.knowledge.monster.water_hound.de: Liquid footprints follow this hound as it pads around the dungeon.  An acrid smell of acid rises from the dog's pelt.
angband.knowledge.monster.chimaera.descr: It is a strange concoction of goat, lion and dragon, with the heads of all three beasts.
angband.knowledge.monster.quylthulg.desc: It is a strange pulsing mound of flesh.
angband.knowledge.monster.sasquatch.desc: A tall shaggy, furry humanoid, it could call the yeti brother.
angband.knowledge.monster.werewolf.descr: It is a huge wolf with eyes that glow with manly intelligence.
angband.knowledge.monster.dark_dwarven_l: A leader of Morgoth's eastern dwarf recruits, dressed in black chainmail and radiating evil power.
angband.knowledge.monster.ranger.descrip: A warrior who is at one with nature.  A master of both bow and sword, with minor spellcasting skills, and animals come to do his bidding.
angband.knowledge.monster.paladin.descri: A warrior for a holy cause.  Unfortunately, his god is not yours, and there is rivalry even between the various gods of Good, so he is your enemy.
angband.knowledge.monster.lugdush_the_ur: A large and powerful orc, captain of one of Saruman's orcish regiments.
angband.knowledge.monster.blue_dragon_ba: It is a glowing blue bat with a sharp tail.
angband.knowledge.monster.scroll_mimic.d: A strange creature that disguises itself as a discarded scroll to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.
angband.knowledge.monster.water_vortex.d: A caustic spinning whirlpool of water.
It is an orcish figure covered in wrappings.
Believed to be an evil relative of the cricket, this creature gets its name from its incessant squeaking, which can best be described as "neek-breek, neek-breek".  The noise can drive people frantic, and worse still, can be heard for quite some distance, alerting other monsters to your presence.
angband.knowledge.monster.ugluk_the_uruk: A strong and cunning orc warrior, the commander of Saruman's orcish horde.
angband.knowledge.monster.killer_stag_be: It is a giant beetle with vicious claws.
angband.knowledge.monster.iron_golem.des: It is a massive metal statue that moves steadily towards you.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_yellow_s: It is a giant scorpion with a sharp stinger.
angband.knowledge.monster.wyvern.descrip: A fast-moving and deadly draconian animal.  Beware its poisonous sting!
angband.knowledge.monster.phase_spider.d: A spider that never seems quite there.  Everywhere you look it is just half-seen in the corner of one eye.
angband.knowledge.monster.black_ooze.des: It is a strangely moving puddle.
angband.knowledge.monster.easterling_cha: A scarred warrior who wields an axe and moves with confidence.
angband.knowledge.monster.azog_enemy_of_: A great orc with a huge iron-clad head, agile and strong.  He is notorious for starting the War of the Dwarves and Orcs by killing Durin's heir, Thrór.
angband.knowledge.monster.brigand.descri: A thief of great power and shifty speed.
angband.knowledge.monster.red_dragon_bat: It is a sharp-tailed bat, wreathed in fire.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_silver_a: A giant silver ant with a caustic bite and hard scales.
angband.knowledge.monster.forest_wight.d: It is a ghostly apparition with a humanoid form.
angband.knowledge.monster.ibun_son_of_mi: One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves.  Ibun is a tricky sorcerous little being, full of mischief.
angband.knowledge.monster.khim_son_of_mi: One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves.  Khîm is a tricky sorcerous little being, full of mischief.
angband.knowledge.monster.4_headed_hydra: A 3-headed hydra with an extra, smouldering, head.
angband.knowledge.monster.mummified_huma: It is a human form encased in mouldy wrappings.
angband.knowledge.monster.vampire_bat.de: A blood-sucking bat that flies at your neck hungrily.
angband.knowledge.monster.sangahyando_of: A Black Númenórean with a blacker heart.
angband.knowledge.monster.angamaite_of_u: A Black Númenórean who hates the men of the west.
angband.knowledge.monster.banshee.descri: It is a ghostly woman's form that wails mournfully.
angband.knowledge.monster.werebear.descr: In the eyes of this bear, there glimmers the faintest light of intelligence.  And then its form begins to change...  The combination of animal cunning, human intelligence and the great physical strength of the bear makes for a dangerous enemy.
angband.knowledge.monster.nruling.descri: Little sparks of flame that dance around you, lashing whips and cursing horribly.
angband.knowledge.monster.necromancer.de: A gaunt figure, clothed in black robes.
angband.knowledge.monster.hill_giant.des: A ten foot tall humanoid with powerful muscles.
angband.knowledge.monster.pukelman.descr: A stumpy figure carved from stone, with glittering eyes, this sentinel strides towards you with deadly intent.
angband.knowledge.monster.stone_troll.de: He is a large, lumpish troll with scabrous black skin.
angband.knowledge.monster.carrion_crawle: A hideous centipede covered in slime and with glowing tentacles around its head.
angband.knowledge.monster.killer_red_bee: It is a giant beetle with poisonous mandibles.
angband.knowledge.monster.abyss_worm_mas: A writhing wormlike shimmer of blackness, large as your arm.  It squirms through air and walls with equal facility, leaving void in its wake.
Clouds of these monsters light up the dungeon - so brightly that you can barely see through them.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_grey_ant: It is an ant encased in an impenetrable exoskeleton.
angband.knowledge.monster.displacer_beas: It is a huge black panther, clubbed tentacles sprouting from its shoulders.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_fire_tic: It is smoking and burning with great heat.
angband.knowledge.monster.cave_ogre.desc: A giant orc-like figure with an awesomely muscled frame.
angband.knowledge.monster.disenchanter_b: A giant bat which feeds on raw magical energy.
angband.knowledge.monster.wolf_chieftain: A great wolf-chieftain whose pack is in the service of the Dark Lord, and whose howls strike fear into even the boldest heart.
angband.knowledge.monster.ghoul.descript: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.
angband.knowledge.monster.mim_betrayer_o: The last of his race, Mîm is a Petty-Dwarf.  Petty-Dwarves are strange creatures, powerful in sorcery and originating in the East.  They have been hunted nearly to extinction by the High Elves.
angband.knowledge.monster.killer_fire_be: It is a giant beetle wreathed in flames.
angband.knowledge.monster.creeping_adama: It appears to be a pile of coins made of precious adamant, slithering toward you on lots of tiny legs.
angband.knowledge.monster.troll_scavenge: A powerful, man-eating troll, its claws foul with the traces of its last kill.
angband.knowledge.monster.vibration_houn: A blurry canine form which seems to be moving as fast as the eye can follow.  You can feel the earth resonating beneath your feet.
angband.knowledge.monster.nexus_hound.de: A locus of conflicting points coalesce to form the vague shape of a huge hound.  Or is it just your imagination?
angband.knowledge.monster.vampire.descri: It is a humanoid with an aura of power.  You notice a sharp set of front teeth.
angband.knowledge.monster.gorgimaera.des: The result of evil experiments, this travesty of nature should never be alive.  It has three heads - goat, dragon and gorgon - all attached to a lion's body.
angband.knowledge.monster.ogre_shaman.de: It is an ogre wrapped in furs and covered in grotesque body paints.
angband.knowledge.monster.shimmering_mol: It is a strange growth on the dungeon floor, glowing and crackling with sparks.
angband.knowledge.monster.frost_giant.de: A twelve foot tall giant covered in furs.
angband.knowledge.monster.spirit_naga.de: A wraithly snake-like form with the torso of a beautiful woman.
angband.knowledge.monster.5_headed_hydra: A 4-headed hydra with an extra head, steaming with acidic vapor.
angband.knowledge.monster.uldor_the_accu: An evil and cunning man from the East.  Having once sworn allegiance to the sons of Fëanor, it was Uldor's treachery that turned the tide of the Battle of Unnumbered Tears in Morgoth's favour.
angband.knowledge.monster.mage.descripti: A mage of some power - you can tell by the size of his hat.
angband.knowledge.monster.mind_flayer.de: A humanoid form with a gruesome head, tentacular mouth, and piercing eyes.  Claws reach out for you and you feel a presence invade your mind.
angband.knowledge.monster.draebor_the_im: An intensely irritating git of a monster.
angband.knowledge.monster.basilisk.descr: A vile reptile that preys on unsuspecting travellers.  Its eyes stare deeply at you and your soul starts to wilt!
angband.knowledge.monster.snow_troll.des: He is a white troll with shaggy fur and powerfully clawed hands.
angband.knowledge.monster.bat_of_gorgoro: Fed with horrid meats and grown to enormous size, this slavering creature seeks livelier prey.
angband.knowledge.monster.spectator.desc: A lesser relative of the beholder: a globular body with a large toothy mouth, a large central eye, and four smaller eyes on stalks protruding from the top of its body.
angband.knowledge.monster.beorn_the_shap: Beorn is only occasionally seen in human form these days, preferring to appear in the shape of a giant black bear: he also prefers the company of beasts to that of humans.  He has never taken kindly to strangers, even in human form.
angband.knowledge.monster.beorn_the_moun: Beorn in his form as a great black bear of the mountains, grown to giant-size in wrath.  The roar of his voice is like drums, and no weapon seems to bite upon him.
angband.knowledge.monster.green_elf_arch: An elf of the Land of the Seven Rivers, whose woodcraft was such that a stranger might pass through their land from end to end and see none of them.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_black_sc: A gleaming black scorpion as large as a lion, with a pulsating stinger and two great deadly claws.
angband.knowledge.monster.purple_worm.de: It is a massive worm form, many feet in length.  Its vast maw drips acid and poison.
angband.knowledge.monster.catoblepas.des: A strange ox-like form with a huge head but a thin, weak neck, it looks like the creation of some deranged alchemist.
angband.knowledge.monster.ring_mimic.des: A strange creature that disguises itself as a discarded ring to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_blue_dra: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a deep blue in hue.  Sparks crackle along its length.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_white_dr: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a frosty white in hue.  Icy blasts of cold air come from it as it breathes.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_green_dr: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a deep green in hue.  Foul gas seeps through its scales.
A shimmering tornado of air, sparks crackle along its length.
angband.knowledge.monster.fire_giant.des: A glowing fourteen foot tall giant.  Flames drip from its red skin.
It is a massive statue of purest mithril.  It looks expensive!
angband.knowledge.monster.skeleton_troll: It is a troll skeleton animated by dark dweomers.
angband.knowledge.monster.manticore.desc: It is a winged lion's body with a human torso and a tail covered in vicious spikes.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_blue_ant: It is a giant ant that crackles with energy.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_army_ant: An armoured form moving with purpose.  Powerful on its own, flee when hordes of them march.
angband.knowledge.monster.grave_wight.de: It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.
angband.knowledge.monster.killer_slicer_: It is a beetle with deadly sharp cutting mandibles and a rock-hard carapace.
angband.knowledge.monster.ogre_chieftain: This ogre is leader of his tribe.  He sneers at you as he advances towards you, wielding a huge club and pushing his own followers rudely aside.
angband.knowledge.monster.ghast.descript: This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs of them.  It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.
angband.knowledge.monster.bert_the_stone: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit.  He has friends called Bill and Tom.
angband.knowledge.monster.bill_the_stone: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit.  He has friends called Bert and Tom.
angband.knowledge.monster.tom_the_stone_: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit.  He has friends called Bert and Bill.
angband.knowledge.monster.ghost.descript: You don't believe in it.  But it believes in you...
angband.knowledge.monster.death_watch_be: It is a giant beetle that produces a chilling sound.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_black_dr: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a darkest black hue.  Acid drips from its body.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_gold_dra: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a tarnished gold hue, and light is reflected from its form.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_red_drag: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a deepest red hue.  Heat radiates from its form.
angband.knowledge.monster.huorn.descript: A tree which has become entish, or maybe an ent which has become tree-ish.
angband.knowledge.monster.serpent_of_the: A great serpent, with coils of steel, a lunge faster than the eye can see, and fangs that drip with acidic poison.  Its eyes are mesmerizing.
angband.knowledge.monster.ogre_mage.desc: A hideous ogre wrapped in black sorcerous robes.
angband.knowledge.monster.nexus_quylthul: It is a very unstable, strange pulsing mound of flesh.
angband.knowledge.monster.southron_assas: A man of Harad clothed in black who moves with blinding speed.
angband.knowledge.monster.memory_moss.de: A mass of green vegetation.  You don't remember seeing anything like it before.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_multi_hu: It has a form that legends are made of.  Beautiful scales of shimmering and magical colours cover it.
angband.knowledge.monster.doombat.descri: It is a fast moving creature of chaos, a gigantic black bat surrounded by flickering bright red flames.
A short, stocky man with an uncanny connection with nature.
angband.knowledge.monster.stone_giant.de: It is eighteen feet tall and looking at you.
angband.knowledge.monster.shadow_drake.d: It is a dragon-like form wrapped in shadow.  Glowing red eyes shine out in the dark, and it is surrounded by an aura of unearthly cold that chills the soul rather than the body.
angband.knowledge.monster.cave_troll.des: He is a vicious monster, feared for his ferocity.
angband.knowledge.monster.mystic.descrip: An adept at unarmed combat, the mystic strikes with stunning power.  He can summon help from nature and is able to focus his power to ease any pain.
angband.knowledge.monster.barrow_wight.d: It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.
angband.knowledge.monster.skeleton_etten: It is the animated form of a massive two-headed troll.
angband.knowledge.monster.chaos_drake.de: A dragon twisted by the forces of chaos.  It seems first ugly, then fair, as its form shimmers and changes in front of your eyes.
angband.knowledge.monster.law_drake.desc: This dragon is clever and cunning.  It laughs at your puny efforts to disturb it.
A mighty dragon, the balance drake seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance, and despises your feeble efforts to destroy evil.
angband.knowledge.monster.ethereal_drake: A dragon of great power, with control over light and dark, the ethereal drake's eyes glare with white hatred from the shadows.
angband.knowledge.monster.fire_elemental: It is a towering inferno of flames.
angband.knowledge.monster.water_elementa: It is a towering tempest of water.
A dragon of strange crystalline form.  Light shines through it, dazzling your eyes with spectra of colour.
angband.knowledge.monster.troll_priest.d: A troll who is so bright he knows how to read.
angband.knowledge.monster.maia.descripti: One of the first children of Eru, currently human-like in form, its body shining with glorious light.  Whether this being has taken allegiance to Morgoth or faces you in combat for some other reason is not clear; all you know is that it stands before you, its eyes ablaze as it prepares its next volley of spells.
angband.knowledge.monster.troll_blackgua: A half-smart, vicious troll with some rudimentary magic and a love of violence.
angband.knowledge.monster.shade.descript: A shadowy form clutches at you from the darkness.  A powerful undead creature with a deadly touch.
angband.knowledge.monster.master_thief.d: Cool and confident, fast and lithe; protect your possessions quickly!
angband.knowledge.monster.ulfang_the_bla: A short and swarthy Easterling dressed in black.  He and his three sons once openly swore allegiance to the High Elves, but were secretly in the pay of Morgoth.
angband.knowledge.monster.lich.descripti: It is a skeletal form dressed in robes.  It radiates vastly evil power.
angband.knowledge.monster.earth_elementa: It is a towering form composed of rock with fists of awesome power.
It is a towering tornado of winds.
angband.knowledge.monster.eog_golem.desc: It is a massive deep brown statue, striding towards you with an all-too-familiar purpose.  Your magic surprisingly feels much less powerful now.
angband.knowledge.monster.wereworm.descr: A huge wormlike shape dripping acid, twisted by evil sorcery into a foul monster that breeds on death.
angband.knowledge.monster.lokkak_the_ogr: An ogre renowned for acts of surpassing cruelty, Lokkak quickly became the leader of a large band of violent ogres.
angband.knowledge.monster.hill_troll.des: Clad only in close-fitting mesh of horny scales (unless that is his skin) this troll strides toward you roaring like a beast, wielding a heavy hammer in his knotted hand.
angband.knowledge.monster.invisible_stal: It is impossible to define its form but its violence is legendary.
Unfettered by the usual constraints of gravity, these unnatural creatures are walking on the walls and even the ceiling!  The earth suddenly feels rather less solid as you see gravity warp all round the monsters.
Bizarrely, this hound seems to be hardly moving at all, yet it approaches you with deadly menace.  It makes you tired just to look at it.
angband.knowledge.monster.impact_hound.d: A deep brown shape is visible before you, its canine form strikes you with an almost physical force.  The dungeon floor buckles as if struck by a powerful blow as it stalks towards you.
angband.knowledge.monster.mumak.descript: A massive elephantine form with eyes twisted by madness.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_fire_ant: A giant ant covered in shaggy fur.  Its powerful jaws glow with heat.
angband.knowledge.monster.chest_mimic.de: A strange creature that disguises itself as a chest to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.  The first that most adventurers realise of the deception is when the seemingly invitingly open lid of the chest suddenly grows teeth and then slams shut on the adventurer's hand...
angband.knowledge.monster.silent_watcher: A figure carved from stone, with three vulture faces whose eyes glow with a malevolent light.
angband.knowledge.monster.olog.descripti: It is a massive intelligent troll with needle-sharp fangs.
angband.knowledge.monster.colbran.descri: A man-shaped form of living lightning.  Sparks and shocks crackle all over this madly capering figure, as it leaps and whirls around and about you.
angband.knowledge.monster.cloud_giant.de: It is a twenty foot tall giant wreathed in clouds.
angband.knowledge.monster.master_vampire: It is a humanoid form dressed in robes.  Power emanates from its chilling frame.
angband.knowledge.monster.ooze_elemental: It is a towering mass of filth, an eyesore of ooze.
angband.knowledge.monster.smoke_elementa: It is a towering blackened form, crackling with heat.
angband.knowledge.monster.xorn.descripti: A huge creature of the element Earth.  Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.
angband.knowledge.monster.colossus.descr: An enormous construct resembling a titan made from stone.  It strides purposefully towards you, swinging its slow fists with earth-shattering power.
angband.knowledge.monster.trapper.descri: A larger cousin of the lurker, this creature traps unsuspecting victims and paralyzes them, to be slowly digested later.
angband.knowledge.monster.bodak.descript: It is a humanoid form composed of flames and hatred.
angband.knowledge.monster.dunadan_of_ang: A necromancer recruited to the evil realm of Angmar during the decline of the North Kingdom.
angband.knowledge.monster.lorgan_chief_o: A mighty warrior from the east, Lorgan hates everything that he cannot control.
angband.knowledge.monster.demonologist.d: A figure twisted by evil standing in robes of deepest crimson.
angband.knowledge.monster.gauth.descript: Another lesser relative of the beholder, this six-eyed creature feeds on magic.
It is a towering glacier of ice.
angband.knowledge.monster.mummified_trol: It is a massive figure clothed in wrappings.  You are wary of its massive fists.
angband.knowledge.monster.spectre.descri: A phantasmal shrieking spirit.  Its wail drives the intense cold of pure evil deep within your body.
angband.knowledge.monster.magma_elementa: It is a towering glowing form of molten hate.
angband.knowledge.monster.killer_iridesc: It is a giant beetle, whose carapace shimmers with vibrant energies.
angband.knowledge.monster.nexus_vortex.d: A maelstrom of potent magical energy.
A whirlpool of intense flame, charring the stones at your feet.
angband.knowledge.monster.mountain_troll: A massive troll, larger and stronger than many men together.  It needs no weapons aside from its massive hands and feet.
angband.knowledge.monster.shardstorm.des: A howling blast of razor-sharp mountain fragments, kept intact by perilous magics.
Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being approaches.
angband.knowledge.monster.mummified_chie: A powerful ruler who refused the summons of Mandos on death, preferring to re-occupy his now embalmed body.  He commands a legion of his former subjects with unearthly shrieks.
angband.knowledge.monster.will_o_the_wis: A strange ball of glowing light.  It disappears and reappears and seems to draw you to it.  You seem somehow compelled to stand still and watch its strange dancing motion.
angband.knowledge.monster.death_knight.d: It is a humanoid figure dressed in armour of an ancient form.  From beneath its helmet, eyes glow a baleful red and seem to pierce you like lances of fire.
angband.knowledge.monster.castamir_the_u: A Black Númenórean who usurped the throne of Gondor, he is treacherous and evil.
angband.knowledge.monster.shimmering_vor: A strange pillar of shining light that hurts your eyes.  Its shape changes constantly as it cuts through the air towards you.  It is like a beacon, waking monsters from their slumber.
angband.knowledge.monster.white_wraith.d: It is a tangible but ghostly form made of white fog.
angband.knowledge.monster.etten.descript: A massive two-headed troll of huge strength, ettens are stupid but violent.  They are also living proof that two heads are not more intelligent than one...
angband.knowledge.monster.abyss_spider.d: A massive spider, heaving the bloated bag of its body between great spined legs.
angband.knowledge.monster.southron_arche: A man of Harad clad in black and red and carrying a longbow.  His quiver is full of red feathered arrows, and carries an insignia of a black serpent.
angband.knowledge.monster.mature_white_d: A large dragon, scales gleaming bright white.
angband.knowledge.monster.mature_blue_dr: A large dragon, scales tinted deep blue.
angband.knowledge.monster.mature_green_d: A large dragon, scales tinted deep green.
angband.knowledge.monster.6_headed_hydra: A 5-headed hydra which seems to have an extra head, if you could just see it properly.
angband.knowledge.monster.night_mare.des: A fearsome skeletal horse with glowing eyes, that watch you with little more than a hatred of all that lives.
angband.knowledge.monster.beholder.descr: A vile creature with one huge central eye, twelve smaller eyes on stalks, and a huge mouth filled with sharp teeth.
angband.knowledge.monster.disenchanter_w: It is a strange mass of squirming worms.  Magical energy crackles around its disgusting form.
angband.knowledge.monster.phantom.descri: An unholy creature of darkness, the aura emanating from this evil being saps your very soul.
angband.knowledge.monster.7_headed_hydra: A 6-headed hydra with an extra head that waves mesmerisingly at you.
angband.knowledge.monster.enchantress.de: This elusive female spellcaster has a special affinity for dragons, whom she rarely fights without.
angband.knowledge.monster.sorcerer.descr: A human figure in robes, he moves with magically improved speed, and his hands are ablur with spell casting.
angband.knowledge.monster.xaren.descript: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn.  Its hide glitters with metal ores.
angband.knowledge.monster.giant_roc.desc: A vast legendary bird, its iron talons rake the most impenetrable of surfaces and its screech echoes through the many winding dungeon corridors.
angband.knowledge.monster.minotaur.descr: It is a cross between a human and a bull.
angband.knowledge.monster.vrock.descript: It is a demon with a long neck and raking claws.
angband.knowledge.monster.death_quasit.d: It is a demon of small stature, but its armoured frame moves with lightning speed and its powers make it a tornado of death and destruction.
angband.knowledge.monster.patriarch.desc: A priest of great power, he is convinced of the righteousness of his beliefs.  Stand in his way at your peril.
angband.knowledge.monster.troll_chieftai: This troll's great strength and size have won it the place of chieftain of its tribe.  It fears nothing.
angband.knowledge.monster.mature_red_dra: A large dragon, scales tinted deep red.
angband.knowledge.monster.mature_gold_dr: A large dragon with scales of gleaming gold.
angband.knowledge.monster.mature_black_d: A large dragon, with scales of deepest black.
angband.knowledge.monster.stiffbeard_sor: A dwarf with plaited beard and painted face, dressed in deepest black.  Power seems to crackle from his stocky frame.
angband.knowledge.monster.master_lich.de: A skeletal form wrapped in robes.  Powerful magic crackles along its bony fingers.
angband.knowledge.monster.gorlim_betraye: This sad creature - once a mighty warrior - betrayed his former friends to Morgoth's army in return for, he thought, safety for himself and his wife.  And so he fell under Morgoth's power and became little more than a mindless servant of evil, even though the other side of his "bargain" was not kept.
angband.knowledge.monster.ranger_chiefta: A chieftain among the Rangers.  His understanding of nature gives him powerful elemental spells to use against you, in addition to his skills as an archer and a warrior.  Furthermore, he is a master of camouflage, so you will need magically enhanced seeing to spot him.
angband.knowledge.monster.kavlax_the_man: A large dragon with a selection of heads, all shouting and arguing as they look for prey, but each with its own deadly breath weapon.
angband.knowledge.monster.hellhound.desc: It is a giant wolf that glows with heat.  Flames pour from its nostrils.
angband.knowledge.monster.black_hearted_: A huorn with a bad heart.
She's upset because you hurt her children.
angband.knowledge.monster.rogrog_the_bla: A massive and cruel troll of great power, drool slides caustically down his muscular frame.  Despite his bulk, he strikes with stunning speed.
angband.knowledge.monster.maia_of_nienna: A servant of Nienna, who grieves for the hurts to the world caused by Morgoth.
angband.knowledge.monster.maia_of_mandos: A servant of Mandos, the summoner of the spirits of the slain.
angband.knowledge.monster.mature_multi_h: A large dragon, scales shimmering many colours.
angband.knowledge.monster.vargo_tyrant_o: A towering fire elemental, Vargo burns everything beyond recognition.
angband.knowledge.monster.waldern_king_o: A towering water elemental, Waldern is master of all things liquid.  Wave after wave drowns your frail body.
angband.knowledge.monster.glabrezu.descr: It is demon with arms and pincers, its form a true mockery of life.
angband.knowledge.monster.quaker_master_: A towering stone elemental stands before you.  The walls and ceiling are reduced to rubble as Quaker advances.
angband.knowledge.monster.ariel_queen_of: A towering air elemental, Ariel, the sorceress, avoids your blows with her extreme speed.
angband.knowledge.monster.multi_hued_hou: Shimmering in rainbow hues, this hound is beautiful and deadly.
angband.knowledge.monster.8_headed_hydra: A 7-headed hydra with an extra head which reeks of death.
angband.knowledge.monster.dread.descript: It is a form that screams its presence against the eye.  Death incarnate, its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe itself struggles to banish it.
angband.knowledge.monster.killer_white_b: A giant beetle with a gleaming white carapace.  The air condenses around its mandibles as it scuttles toward you.
angband.knowledge.monster.rotting_quylth: It is a pulsing flesh mound that reeks of death and putrefaction.
angband.knowledge.monster.nalfeshnee.des: It is a large demon with the head of a giant boar.  Flames run up and down its length.
angband.knowledge.monster.undead_beholde: A beholder which has cheated death.  Black nether storms rage around the bloodshot pupil of its central giant eye, and light seems to bend as it sucks its power from the very air around it.  Your soul chills as it drains your vitality for its evil enchantments.
angband.knowledge.monster.demonic_quylth: A pile of pulsing flesh that reeks of sulfur.  The world itself seems to cry out against it.
angband.knowledge.monster.draconic_quylt: It looks like it was once a dragon corpse, now deeply infected with magical bacteria that make it pulse in a foul and degrading way.
angband.knowledge.monster.greater_basili: A large basilisk, whose shape resembles that of a great wyrm.
angband.knowledge.monster.berserker.desc: Even the strongest of normal human warriors fears the Berserker - the one who can drive himself into such a terrible battle-frenzy that he can survive blows which should kill him, and still apparently feel no pain.  He tramples weaker creatures underfoot in his eagerness to get to his real enemy, and his battle-cry strikes terror into his foes.
angband.knowledge.monster.cyclops.descri: A gigantic ugly humanoid with but one eye and very thick skin.
angband.knowledge.monster.grey_wraith.de: A tangible but ghostly form, made of grey fog.  The air around it feels deathly cold.
angband.knowledge.monster.lord_of_carn_d: An evil priest, dressed all in black.  Deadly spells hit you at an alarming rate as his black spiked mace rains down blow after blow on your pitiful frame.
angband.knowledge.monster.vampire_lord.d: A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.
angband.knowledge.monster.marilith.descr: She is a demon of female form with many arms, each bearing deadly weapons.
angband.knowledge.monster.death_mold.des: It is the epitome of all that is evil, in a mold.  Its lifeless form draws power from sucking the souls of those that approach it, a nimbus of pure evil surrounds it.  Luckily for you, it can't move.
angband.knowledge.monster.ancient_spider: A foul creature of spider form, older even than the pits of Angband.
A terrifying sight: a winged creature greater than any bird you have ever seen, and with no feathers on its horrid black leathery wings.  Descended from a creature of an older world perhaps, bred by Sauron to be a winged steed for his Ringwraiths.
angband.knowledge.monster.gorgon.descrip: This creature of legend has not just a serpent's body, but snakes for hair.  Her scales rattle as she slithers towards you, eyes blazing, venom dripping from her ghastly mouth.
angband.knowledge.monster.storm_giant.de: It is a twenty-five foot tall giant wreathed in lightning.
It is a massive humanoid demon wreathed in flames.
angband.knowledge.monster.black_wraith.d: A figure that seems made of void, its strangely human shape is cloaked in shadow.  It reaches out at you.
angband.knowledge.monster.eol_the_dark_e: A lord of the Teleri, Eöl is a mighty metalsmith, the only one to ever forge weapons of meteorite iron.  The mortal enemy of the Eldar, he is currently fleeing their wrath, following the murder of Princess Aredhel of Gondolin.
angband.knowledge.monster.ancient_blue_d: A huge draconic form.  Lightning crackles along its length.
angband.knowledge.monster.ancient_white_: A huge draconic form.  Frost covers it from head to tail.
angband.knowledge.monster.ancient_green_: A huge draconic form enveloped in clouds of poisonous vapour.
angband.knowledge.monster.death_drake.de: It is a dragon-like form wrapped in darkness.  You cannot make out its true form but you sense its evil.
angband.knowledge.monster.great_crystal_: A huge crystalline dragon.  Its claws could cut you to shreds and its teeth are razor sharp.  Strange colours ripple through it as it moves in the light.
angband.knowledge.monster.ethereal_drago: This terrible dragon is a master of light and dark.  Its form disappears from sight as it cloaks itself in unearthly shadows.
A lord of all that is natural, skilled in the mystic ways.  He is a master of martial arts and is at one with nature, able to summon help from the wild if need be.
angband.knowledge.monster.shadow.descrip: A mighty spirit of darkness of vaguely humanoid form.  Razor-edged claws reach out to end your life as it glides towards you, seeking to suck the energy from your soul to feed its power.
angband.knowledge.monster.the_balrog_of_: A huge Balrog surrounded by raging pillars of fire, this is indeed a terrible opponent.  Wielding a great whip of fire and a blazing sword, his fury blisters your skin and melts your flesh!
angband.knowledge.monster.ancient_black_: A huge draconic form.  Pools of acid melt the floor around it.
angband.knowledge.monster.ancient_red_dr: A huge draconic form.  Wisps of smoke steam from its nostrils and the extreme heat surrounding it makes you gasp for breath.
angband.knowledge.monster.ancient_gold_d: A huge draconic form wreathed in a nimbus of light.  Its roar stuns and deafens you.
angband.knowledge.monster.nether_hound.d: You feel a soul-tearing chill upon viewing this beast, a ghostly form of darkness in the shape of a large dog.
angband.knowledge.monster.time_hound.des: You get a terrible sense of deja vu, or is it a premonition?  All at once you see a little puppy and a toothless old dog.  Perhaps you should give up and go to bed.
angband.knowledge.monster.plasma_hound.d: The very air warps as pure elemental energy stalks towards you in the shape of a giant hound.  Your hair stands on end and your palms itch as you sense trouble.
angband.knowledge.monster.harowen_the_bl: He is a master of disguise, an expert of stealth, a genius at traps, and moves with blinding speed.  Check your pockets!
A servant of Oromë, hunter of monsters and fell beasts.
angband.knowledge.monster.hasty_ent.desc: Ents are not altogether on anybody's side, because nobody is altogether on their side.  This one seems quite roused, and does not seem to be on your side.
angband.knowledge.monster.itangast_the_f: A mighty ancient dragon, Itangast's form scorches your flesh.  Wisps of smoke curl up from his nostrils as he regards you with disdain.
angband.knowledge.monster.hezrou.descrip: A sluggish demon of lizard form, firing powerful missiles.  From the terribly oversized jaws to the stumpy lashing tail, pools of burning acid froth and sizzle.
angband.knowledge.monster.ancient_multi_: A huge draconic form.  Many colours ripple down its massive frame.  Few live to see another.
angband.knowledge.monster.scatha_the_wor: An ancient and wise Dragon.  Scatha has grown clever over the long years.  His scales are covered with frost, and his breath sends a shower of ice into the air.
angband.knowledge.monster.the_phoenix.de: A massive glowing eagle bathed in flames.  The searing heat chars your skin and melts your armour.
angband.knowledge.monster.drolem.descrip: A constructed dragon, the drolem has massive strength.  Powerful spells weaved during its creation make it a fearsome adversary.  Its eyes show little intelligence, but it has been instructed to destroy all it meets.
angband.knowledge.monster.demilich.descr: A lich who is partially immaterial, on its way to a new, ethereal form.
angband.knowledge.monster.dreadmaster.de: It is an unlife of power almost unequaled.  An affront to existence, its very touch abuses and disrupts the flow of life, and its unearthly limbs, of purest black, crush rock and flesh with ease.
A form that hurts the eye, death permeates the air around it.  As it nears you, a coldness saps your soul.
angband.knowledge.monster.shelob_spider_: Shelob is an enormous bloated spider, the last daughter of Ungoliant the Unlight.  Her poison is legendary, as is her ego.  She normally guards the pass through Cirith Ungol, but occasionally goes out foraging for food to feed her voracious appetite.
angband.knowledge.monster.dracolich.desc: The skeletal form of a once-great dragon, enchanted by magic most perilous.  Its animated form strikes with speed and drains life from its prey to satisfy its hunger.
angband.knowledge.monster.dracolisk.desc: A mixture of dragon and basilisk, the dracolisk stares at you with deep piercing eyes, its evil breath burning the ground where it stands.
angband.knowledge.monster.ar_pharazon_th: Last and proudest king of ancient Númenor.  Corrupted by power and avarice, he fell victim to Sauron's wiles, tried to fight the Valar themselves, and condemned Númenor to oblivion.
angband.knowledge.monster.barbazu.descri: A foul, humanoid creature with a long tail, clawed hands and feet, and a disgusting, wiry, snaky beard.  They are the elite shock troops of the hells, capable of a terrifying berserk fury.
angband.knowledge.monster.lesser_titan.d: It is a humanoid figure thirty feet tall that gives off an aura of power and hate.
angband.knowledge.monster.grand_master_m: He is one of the few true masters of the art, being extremely skillful in all forms of unarmed combat and controlling the world's natural creatures with disdainful ease.
angband.knowledge.monster.hand_druj.desc: A skeletal hand floating in the air, motionless except for its flexing fingers.
angband.knowledge.monster.9_headed_hydra: A massive legendary hydra, like an 8-headed hydra, but with a massive extra head that opens its mighty jaws at you.  Its many eyes stare at you as clouds of vapour rise from its seething form.  And it grows new heads as fast as you chop them off.
angband.knowledge.monster.baphomet_the_m: A fearsome bull-headed monster, Baphomet swings a mighty axe as he curses all that defy him.
A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others.  It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.
angband.knowledge.monster.fundin_blueclo: He is one of the greatest dwarven priests to walk the earth.  Fundin has earned a high position in the church, and his skill with both weapon and spell only justify his position further.  His combination of both dwarven strength and priestly wisdom are a true match for any adventurer.
angband.knowledge.monster.gilim_the_gian: Known as the giant of winter and the northern reaches, he is tall even among giants, and his name is cursed in many lands.
angband.knowledge.monster.maia_of_yavann: A servant of Yavanna Kementári, Queen of the Earth, the Giver of Fruits and lover of all things that grow.
angband.knowledge.monster.maia_of_aule.d: A servant of Aulë the Smith, lord of all the substances of Arda and friend of the Noldor.
angband.knowledge.monster.great_earth_el: Appearing as a giant of stone, this mighty elemental seems to draw its power from the very fabric of the dungeon.
An awesome vortex of pure magic, power radiates from its frame.
angband.knowledge.monster.saruman_of_man: Originally known as the White, Saruman fell prey to Sauron's wiles.  He seeks to emulate him and breeds orcs and trolls to fight for him.  He searches forever for the One Ring, to become a mighty Sorcerer-King of the world.
angband.knowledge.monster.nightwing.desc: Everywhere colours seem paler and the air chillier.  At the centre of the cold stands a mighty figure.  Its wings envelop you in the chill of death as the nightwing reaches out to draw you into oblivion.  Your muscles sag and your mind loses all will to fight as you stand in awe of this mighty being.
angband.knowledge.monster.bile_demon.des: It's big.  It's fat.  It's red.  It's ugly.  It's got a severe attack of highly poisonous flatulence.  And its insides are corrosive.  All of which go together to make the single most repulsive sight - and smell - you have ever experienced.
angband.knowledge.monster.dreadlord.desc: It is a massive form of animated death, its colour deeper than black.  It drinks in light, and space around it is twisted and torn by the weight of its evil.  It is unlife and it knows nothing but the stealing of souls and the stench of death.  Flee its hunger!
angband.knowledge.monster.smaug_the_gold: Smaug is one of the Urulóki that still survive, a fire-drake of immense cunning and intelligence.  His speed through air is matched by few other dragons and his dragonfire is what legends are made of; he is believed to be the greatest dragon still surviving into the Third Age.
angband.knowledge.monster.werewolf_of_sa: A massive wolf, appearing like a mighty shadow.  Its glowing red eyes glare malevolently as it defends its evil master's fortress.
angband.knowledge.monster.spider_of_gorg: One of the hideous brood of Ungoliant, spawned in the endless shadow of Nan Dungortheb beneath the mountains of Ered Gorgoroth.
angband.knowledge.monster.chaos_hound.de: A constantly changing canine form, this hound rushes towards you as if expecting mayhem and chaos ahead.  It appears to have an almost kamikaze relish for combat.  You suspect all may not be as it seems.
angband.knowledge.monster.archlich.descr: A lich who has reached its ultimate evolutionary stage: a completely immaterial state.
angband.knowledge.monster.maia_of_ulmo.d: A servant of Ulmo, Lord of Waters, who speaks to those who dwell in Middle-earth with voices that are heard only as the music of water.
angband.knowledge.monster.great_water_el: A mighty column of water, terrible as a mounting wave that strides to the land.
angband.knowledge.monster.the_mouth_of_s: The Mouth of Sauron is a mighty spell caster.  So old that even he cannot remember his own name, his power and evil are undeniable.  He believes unshakably that he is unbeatable and laughs as he weaves his awesome spells.
angband.knowledge.monster.osyluth.descri: It is a demon made almost entirely out of bones.  It is humanoid, but with a large tail similar to that of a giant scorpion, and emits a foul smell of decay and rot.  They are despised even in the hells.
angband.knowledge.monster.feanorian_raid: A veteran of the battles waged by Fëanor and his sons in pursuit of the Silmarils, he attacks you with agility, power and cruelty.
angband.knowledge.monster.eye_druj.descr: A bloodshot eyeball floating in the air, you'd be forgiven for assuming it harmless.
A forty foot tall humanoid that shakes the ground as it walks.  The power radiating from its frame shakes your courage, its hatred inspired by your defiance.
angband.knowledge.monster.tevildo_prince: Master of all things feline, Tevildo serves his master Morgoth well.  He delights in small torments and cunning stratagems, and laughs merrily as he bats you about.
angband.knowledge.monster.thuringwethil_: Chief messenger between Sauron and Morgoth, she is surely the most deadly of her vampire race.  At first she is charming to meet, but her wings and eyes give away her true form.
angband.knowledge.monster.beholder_hive_: A hive mother of the race of beholders, she can summon her brood to her aid whenever she wishes.
angband.knowledge.monster.jabberwock.des: "Beware the Jabberwock, my son!  The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!"  Run and run quickly, for death incarnate chases behind you!
angband.knowledge.monster.tselakus_the_d: This huge affront to existence twists and tears at the fabric of space.  A master of mighty magic, Tselakus hungers for your tender flesh.  Darkness itself recoils from the touch of Tselakus as he leaves a trail of death and destruction.  Tselakus is a being of sneering contempt, laughing at your pitiful efforts to defy him.  Mighty claws rend reality as he annihilates all in his path to your soul!
angband.knowledge.monster.bone_golem.des: A skeletal form, black as night, constructed from the bones of its previous victims.
angband.knowledge.monster.hound_of_tinda: Bodies of death, receptacles of all foulness, they emerge like smoke from the angles of time, ravenous and snarling and unsatisfied.
Known as the giant of summer and the south, he towers above you like a great elm.  In his right hand, he holds the longest sword you have ever beheld.
angband.knowledge.monster.nightcrawler.d: This intensely evil creature bears the form of a gargantuan black worm.  Its gaping maw is a void of blackness, acid drips from its steely hide.  It is like nothing you have ever seen before, and a terrible chill runs down your spine as you face it.
angband.knowledge.monster.gelugon.descri: This demon from the icy regions is a truly terrifying sight.  It has an extremely large, insect-like body towering a full twelve feet tall, with great claws on its hands and pincers on its mouth, and its head bulges with great multi-faceted eyes.  Its tail is covered with razor-sharp spikes.
angband.knowledge.monster.great_storm_wy: A vast dragon of power.  Storms and lightning crash around its titanic form.  Deep blue scales reflect the flashes and highlight the creature's great muscles.  It regards you with contempt.
angband.knowledge.monster.great_ice_wyrm: An immense dragon capable of awesome destruction.  You have never felt such extreme cold, or witnessed such an icy stare.  Begone quickly or feel its wrath!
angband.knowledge.monster.great_swamp_wy: A truly enormous dragon with great powers.  The foul gases issuing from the beast nearly make you vomit; and while you may try to hold your breath as you fight it, it sees no reason to do likewise.
A servant of Manwë Súlimo, the first of all Kings, lord of the realm of Arda and ruler of all that dwell therein.
A servant of Varda, Lady of the Stars, who the elves call Elbereth and love above all the Valar.
angband.knowledge.monster.greater_demoni: A massive pulsating mound of flesh, strongly reeking of sulfur.
angband.knowledge.monster.greater_dracon: A massive mound of multi-hued scaled flesh, throbbing and pulsating.
angband.knowledge.monster.greater_rottin: A massive pile of rotting flesh.  A disgusting stench fills the air as it throbs and writhes.
A giant humanoid demon wielding a massive, heavy and sharp scythe.  Feared by foes and friends alike when it flies into one of its berserk rages, the Horned Reaper will cut down anything in its path between it and you - even the minions it has just summoned.
angband.knowledge.monster.osse_herald_of: Encrusted with barnacles, slimy and dripping, the Maia of the untamed sea has dragged himself down into Angband to send you to a watery grave. Ossë is the most powerful and heartless of Ulmo's servants and embodies the untamed power of the ocean.  Terror grows in your heart with each squelching step of his approach.
angband.knowledge.monster.great_hell_wyr: A vast dragon of immense power.  Fire leaps continuously from its huge form.  The air around it scalds you.  Its slightest glance burns you, and you truly realize how insignificant you are.
angband.knowledge.monster.great_bile_wyr: A huge and very powerful dragon.  Great steaming pools of acid drip from its form onto the ground.  You shudder when you see the acid eating away the very stones of the dungeon - what could it do to you?
angband.knowledge.monster.great_wyrm_of_: A dragon of gigantic proportions, with destructive abilities to match.  The sheer loudness of its roar leaves you stunned and unable to think clearly enough to defend yourself adequately.
angband.knowledge.monster.nightwalker.de: A huge giant garbed in black, it breaks your armour from your back, leaving you defenseless against its evil wrath.  It can smell your fear, and you in turn smell the awful stench of death as this ghastly figure strides towards you menacingly.
angband.knowledge.monster.omarax_the_eye: A beholder of great size and age, floating in the air.  His gaze seems to shred your soul and his spells crush your will.  He is ancient, his history steeped in forgotten evils, his atrocities numerous and sickening.
angband.knowledge.monster.skull_druj.des: A glowing skull possessed by sorcerous power.  It need not move, but merely blast you with mighty magic as it speaks the words of power.
angband.knowledge.monster.black_reaver.d: A humanoid form, black as night, advancing steadily and unstoppably, even the very rock of the dungeon cannot prevent it reaching you.
angband.knowledge.monster.aether_hound.d: A shifting, swirling form.  It seems to be all colours and sizes and shapes, though the dominant form is that of a huge dog.  You feel very uncertain all of a sudden.
angband.knowledge.monster.great_wyrm_of_: A massive dragon of changing form.  As you watch, it appears first fair and then foul.  Its body is twisted by chaotic forces as it strives to stay real.  Its very existence distorts the universe around it.
A massive dragon of powerful intellect.  It seeks to dominate the universe and despises all other life.  It sees all who do not obey it as mere insects to be crushed underfoot.
angband.knowledge.monster.ungoliant_the_: This enormous, hideous spirit of void is in the form of a spider of immense proportions.  She is surrounded by a cloud of Unlight as she sucks in all living light into her bloated body, and breathes out the blackest of darkness.  She is always ravenously hungry and would even eat herself to avoid starvation.
angband.knowledge.monster.bronze_golem.d: A gigantic four-armed animated bronze statue of demonic shape, glowing with great heat.
angband.knowledge.monster.glaurung_fathe: Glaurung is the father of all dragons, and was for a long time the most powerful.  Though this is no longer so, he still has full command over his brood and can command them to appear whenever he so wishes.  He is the definition of dragonfire.
angband.knowledge.monster.master_quylthu: A giant seething mass of flesh, overwhelming you with monster after monster.
angband.knowledge.monster.makar_the_warr: A battle-hungry spirit from amongst the Ainur, who built a grim hall in the early days of Arda to host endless battles.  When not at home, he and his sister Meássë hunt and seek out the turmoils caused by Morgoth.
angband.knowledge.monster.feagwath_the_u: A stench of corruption and decay surrounds this sorcerer, who has clearly risen from the dead to continue his foul plots and schemes.
angband.knowledge.monster.pit_fiend.desc: Appearing as a giant, clawed and winged humanoid with a scaly red body and massive fangs dripping a foul green liquid, the pit fiend is a dreadful enemy from the lowest depths of the hells.  They are often the commanders of vast demon armies.
angband.knowledge.monster.uvatha_the_hor: A tall black cloaked Ringwraith, he is a master of horsemanship.  He longs to taste your blood.
angband.knowledge.monster.serpent_of_cha: Writhing coil upon coil, this mighty spawn of chaos constantly disintegrates and reforms before your dazzled eyes.  It seeks to obliterate you utterly; beware!
angband.knowledge.monster.adunaphel_the_: A sorceress in life, Adunaphel quickly fell under Sauron's sway and the power of the rings.
angband.knowledge.monster.qlzqqlzuup_the: A gigantic seething mass of flesh, Qlzqqlzuup changes colours in front of your eyes.  Pulsating first one colour then the next, it knows only it must bring help to protect itself.
angband.knowledge.monster.akhorahil_the_: A mighty sorcerer King, Akhorahil was blind in life.  With powerful enchantments, he created jewelled eyes that enabled him to see better than any ordinary man ever could.
angband.knowledge.monster.fury.descripti: A female embodiment of rage, intent on tearing your mind and body apart.
angband.knowledge.monster.great_wyrm_of_: A massive dragon of hideous form.  From its shadowy aura comes the stench of the underworld.  Its body is twisted by chaotic forces as it strives to stay real.  Its very existence distorts the universe around it.
angband.knowledge.monster.sky_dragon.des: A wrathful dragon, of a breed that even legends do not mention, rushing towards you like a thunderbolt.  Few ever face the wyrms of the exotic airs; fewer live to tell the tale.
angband.knowledge.monster.wiruin_the_mae: A violent icy whirlpool, brought from the frozen wastes of the Helcaraxë by Morgoth as guard and entertainment.  Smaller vortices arise on its edges, and you feel as if you will never be free of its deafening roar.
angband.knowledge.monster.ren_the_unclea: Ren was an insane eastern king who believed himself to be the son of a volcano god.  At an early age his sanity was destroyed by a plague that wiped out his family, and he never recovered.
angband.knowledge.monster.maeglin_the_tr: The son of Eöl the Dark Elf, Maeglin is every bit as evil as his father and more.  His greed for gold led him to betray the Hidden Kingdom of Gondolin to Morgoth's forces.  He is a mighty warrior himself, and some of Morgoth's greatest servants answer to his call.
angband.knowledge.monster.ji_indur_dawnd: This Ringwraith was a weak-minded sorcerer-king who fell easily under Sauron's power.
angband.knowledge.monster.great_wyrm_of_: A massive dragon, one of the mightiest of dragonkind.  It is thousands of years old and seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance.  It sees you as an upstart troublemaker without the wisdom to control your actions.  It will destroy you.
A gigantic dragon whose scales shimmer in myriad hues.
angband.knowledge.monster.pazuzu_lord_of: A winged humanoid demon, Pazuzu grins inhumanely at you as he decides your fate.
angband.knowledge.monster.dwar_dog_lord_: Dwar had a special affinity for dogs in life, and can still command them at will.  He howls maniacally as he reaches out to destroy you.
angband.knowledge.monster.hoarmurath_of_: A Ringwraith powerful in fell sorcery, he yearns for the life he has lost for an unlife of everlasting torment.
angband.knowledge.monster.draugluin_sire: Draugluin provides Sauron with a fearsome personal guard.  He is an enormous wolf inhabited with a human spirit.  He is chief of all his kind.
angband.knowledge.monster.khamul_the_bla: A warrior-king of the East.  Khamûl is a powerful opponent, his skill in combat awesome and his form twisted by evil cunning.
angband.knowledge.monster.cantoras_the_s: A legion of evil undead druj animating the skeleton of a once mighty sorcerer.  His power is devastating and his speed unmatched in the underworld.  Flee his wrath!
angband.knowledge.monster.greater_balrog: Originally of the semi-divine Maiar, this evil spirit swore allegiance to Morgoth at the beginning of time and is now one of his most terrible demonic servants.  With its flaming whip and sword it seeks to destroy you.
angband.knowledge.monster.the_witch_king: The most fell of all Sauron's captains: King of Angmar, Sorcerer, Ringwraith, Lord of the Nazgûl, a spear of terror in the hand of Sauron, shadow of despair.  His spells are lethal and his combat blows crushingly hard.  He moves at speed, and commands legions of evil to do his bidding.  It is said that he is fated never to die by the hand of mortal man.
angband.knowledge.monster.ancalagon_the_: "Rushing Jaws" is his name, and death is his game; the greatest and most terrible of all dragonkind, his power dismayed even the Valar for a time.
The Tarrasque is a massive reptile of legend, rumoured to be unkillable and immune to magic.  Fear its anger, for its devastation is unmatched!
angband.knowledge.monster.measse_the_blo: Sister of Makar the Warrior, she would shout encouragement to the warriors of their hall and heal their wounds so they could battle on, until her arms were reddened to the elbow.  Meássë is delighted by all violence, and recruits any beings of like abilities to her service.
angband.knowledge.monster.lungorthin_the: A massive form cloaked in flame.  Lungorthin stares balefully at you with eyes that smoulder red.  The dungeon floor where he stands is scorched by the heat of his body.
angband.knowledge.monster.huan_wolfhound: The wolfhound of the Valar, Huan has served many masters in his time, from Celegorm son of Fëanor to Beren son of Barahir: but now he runs wild and acknowledges no master save himself, as he hunts alone for his nemesis - Carcharoth, the terrible wolf of Angband.
angband.knowledge.monster.carcharoth_the: The first guard of Angband, Carcharoth, also known as 'The Red Maw', is the greatest wolf to ever walk the earth.  He is highly intelligent and a deadly opponent in combat.
angband.knowledge.monster.vecna_the_empe: The greatest of all undead sorcerers, even the gods once feared him.  This ancient shadow of death wilts every living thing it passes.
angband.knowledge.monster.storm_of_unmag: Howling through the disintegrating dungeon, this whirlpool of Unmagic rips the enchantments from everything it touches.
angband.knowledge.monster.gothmog_the_hi: Gothmog is the Chief Balrog in Morgoth's personal guard.  He is renowned for slaying Fëanor and Fingon, two of the High Kings of the Noldor, and has never been defeated in combat.  With his whip of flame and awesome fiery breath he saved his master from Ungoliant's rage.
angband.knowledge.monster.sauron_the_sor: Greatest and most terrible of the servants of Morgoth, creator of the One Ring.  A sorcerer of dreadful powers, master of shadows and of phantoms, foul in wisdom, cruel in strength, misshaping what he rules, lord of werewolves; his dominion is torment.  He has many servants, and rarely fights without them.
angband.knowledge.monster.wolf_sauron.de: Sauron's form as the mightiest wolf to walk the world.
angband.knowledge.monster.serpent_sauron: Sauron's form as a serpent: poisonous, biting, spitting, and threatening to crush you in its mighty coils.
angband.knowledge.monster.vampire_sauron: Sauron's form as a vampire, great as a dark cloud across the moon.
angband.knowledge.monster.morgoth_lord_o: He is the Master of the Pits of Angband.  His figure is like a black mountain crowned with lightning.  He rages with everlasting anger, his body scarred by Fingolfin's eight mighty wounds.  He can never rest from his pain, but seeks forever to dominate all that is light and good in the world.  He is the origin of man's fear of darkness and created many foul creatures with his evil powers.  Orcs, Dragons, and Trolls are his most foul corruptions, causing much pain and suffering in the world to please him.  His disgusting visage, twisted with evil, is crowned with iron, the two remaining Silmarils forever burning him.  Grond, the mighty Hammer of the Underworld, cries defiance as he strides towards you to crush you to a pulp!

You become immune to fear at level 30.

You may obtain a perfect success rate with magic.
Your bolt spells frequently turn into beams.
You may choose your own spells to study.
You are extra persuasive to monsters.
You gain stealth in, can see in, and resist the dark.
You can bash monsters with a shield in melee.
You resist nether, but are hurt by holy attacks.

You draw power from the thrill of combat, represented by Spell Points (SP).  You gain SP when damaged by an enemy or when you attack in melee.  As your blood cools your power fades; you lose SP at half the rate other classes gain them.  When you spend SP by casting a spell you regain some health, and fading SP replenish your health more efficiently.  The more damaged you are, the bigger these health gains will be.
You sometimes create earthquakes on impact.
You are afraid of melee, and bad at shooting and casting spells.
